procedure_text: 向反应瓶中加入叔丁醇350mL，开动搅拌，室温下将6.9g氢氧化钾(85％，0.105mol)滴入其中，待氢氧化钾分散均匀后，控制釜温在25℃，将34.8g 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯(98％，0.1mol)倒入釜中进行碱解反应，反应过程微微放热，控制釜温为25℃，反应7h。反应结束，液相色谱中控2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐归一含量为98.3％，负压脱尽溶剂直接用于后续醚化反应。
procedure_summary: Potassium hydroxide is dripped into tert-butanol at room temperature and, once it has dispersed evenly, the methyl benzoate ester is poured in and held at the controlled kettle temperature to cleave the methyl ester to its potassium salt. In-process liquid chromatography measures the content of the potassium salt, and the solvent is then stripped off under reduced pressure so the residue can be used directly in the etherification.
notes: Step marker is the document's own (1); this patent does not use the N、 markers the pass prompt describes. Chinese heading of the step is 2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸盐的制备 (preparation of the 2-chloro-3-bromomethyl-4-methylsulfonylbenzoate salt), which names the salt without a counter-ion; A1 carries that counter-ion-free name as a separate unresolved record and it is deliberately not repeated in compounds[] here, because the prose of this step names the potassium salt and that is the compound that was actually formed. CLASS: the patent calls the transformation 碱解反应 (base cleavage). It removes the methyl ester without touching the benzylic bromide, so hydrolysis is the closest member of the allowed list; ester_formation is the wrong direction and salt_formation alone would describe only the counter-ion, not the bond broken. Confidence is medium because no water is charged, the medium is a tertiary alcohol and the base is solid 85 percent potassium hydroxide, so the cleavage is not a classical aqueous saponification; named_reaction is left null rather than stretching to saponification. REACTOR: the text opens with 反应瓶 (reaction flask) and then twice says 釜 (kettle) for the same vessel (控制釜温, 倒入釜中); no volume and no vessel type beyond that is given, and the mixed wording is recorded rather than resolved. 开动搅拌 says stirring was started without saying how, so stirring.type is left null. The 85 percent and 98 percent figures are reagent strengths and are recorded as purity_pct on the compounds, not as conditions.concentration. 滴入 (dripped in) is printed for potassium hydroxide, which is a solid with no solvent stated for it, and the next clause has it dispersing rather than dissolving; transcribed as printed. ARITHMETIC: both printed mass/mole pairs close once the stated strengths are applied. Potassium hydroxide 6.9 g at 85 percent is 5.87 g over 0.105 mol, implying 55.9 against 56.11 for KOH. The ester 34.8 g at 98 percent is 34.10 g over 0.1 mol, implying 341.0 against 341.6 for C10H10BrClO4S. No product mass is printed for this step, so there is nothing to check on the product side and no mass balance flag is raised. DRAWING: the scheme at line 356 draws the methyl ester as reactant, KOH on the arrow and the POTASSIUM salt as product, all of which agree with the prose, so no drawing conflict is raised here. tert-butanol is in the procedure but not on the arrow, which is ordinary omission of a solvent from a scheme and is not flagged as a written reagent missing from the drawing.

procedure_text: 向反应釜中加入150mL三氟乙醇，开动搅拌，室温下投入20g氢化钾(30％，0.15mol)，搅拌至溶解完全，经脱溶后得到三氟乙醇醇钾固体，密封备用。
procedure_summary: Potassium hydride is charged into trifluoroethanol at room temperature and stirred until dissolution is complete, deprotonating the alcohol. Stripping off the excess alcohol leaves the potassium alkoxide as a solid, which is sealed and kept for the etherification.
notes: STEP COUNT AND LABEL: the patent prints this paragraph inside its step (2), but it is a separate transformation with its own charge and its own isolated, sealed product, so it gets its own record. It is given the label Alkoxide Preparation rather than a Step 2a so that the two document markers, (1) and (2), keep their own records and labels. With this record the section holds three reactions, which matches A0's estimate of three. CLASS: no member of the allowed list names a deprotonation. salt_formation is the closest, because the product is the potassium salt of the alcohol, and the confidence is medium for that reason; the transformation tag says deprotonation, which is what actually happens. CONDITIONS: 室温下投入 gives room temperature and no number, so temperature.value_c is null. No reaction time is printed; the stated endpoint is 搅拌至溶解完全 (stirred until completely dissolved), which is recorded as the process_control criterion with no method, since the text names none. The vessel is 反应釜 (reaction kettle) here, where step (1) said 反应瓶; no volume is given. 密封备用 (sealed for later use) is storage of the product, not a reaction atmosphere, so atmosphere is left null. AS PRINTED: 20 g of 30 percent potassium hydride is an unusual way to specify a hydride, and a hydride does not dissolve, it is consumed; both are transcribed as printed and not reinterpreted. The evolution of hydrogen that this reaction implies is not mentioned by the patent, so safety_notes is empty and no hazard of my own is added; the pyrophoric tag reflects the reagent identity only. ARITHMETIC: the potassium hydride figures close. 20 g at 30 percent is 6.0 g over 0.15 mol, implying 40.0 against 40.11 for KH, so molar_mass_inconsistent is NOT raised for this hydride. The alcohol is charged by volume only, 150 mL, with no mass and no mole figure, so the alcohol to hydride ratio is not stated and molar_ratio_text is null; on volume alone the alcohol is in large excess and is the medium. DRAWING: no arrow is drawn for this preparation. The alkoxide appears only as the condition text CF3CH2OK on the single arrow of the step (2) scheme at line 363, which agrees with the prose on the identity of the alkoxide and on its potassium counter-ion. An absent arrow is not a drawing conflict, so none is flagged.

procedure_text: 向三氟乙醇醇钾中加入200mL  THF，搅拌溶解后控制釜温在5℃，将步骤(1)制备得到的2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐(98.3％，0.1mol)分八次加入反应瓶中，总加料时间为3h，加毕保温反应3h。反应完毕，负压脱溶，釜残加水120mL，搅拌溶解后滴加浓盐酸将体系pH值酸化至2，之后经过滤、水淋洗、烘干得到产物33.0g，HPLC定量得目标化合物2-氯-3-(2,2,2-三氟乙氧基)甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸含量为98.2％，以2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸甲酯计两步反应收率93.5％。
procedure_summary: The solid potassium alkoxide is dissolved in tetrahydrofuran and cooled, and the potassium benzoate salt from the first step is added in portions over several hours, after which the mixture is held at temperature so the alkoxide displaces the benzylic bromide to give the ether. The solvent is stripped off under reduced pressure, the residue is dissolved in water and acidified with concentrated hydrochloric acid, and the precipitated free acid is filtered off, rinsed with water and dried.
notes: Step marker is the document's own (2). Its first paragraph, the alkoxide preparation, is a separate record (Example 5_Alkoxide Preparation); this record covers the etherification paragraph only. A page break (page p12) falls between the two paragraphs. DRAWING CONFLICT: the scheme at line 363 draws the SODIUM salt (C9H7BrClNaO4S, CS(=O)(=O)c1ccc(C(=O)[O-])c(Cl)c1CBr.[Na+]) as the reactant of the arrow, while the prose of this step names the potassium salt (2-氯-3-溴甲基-4-甲磺酰基苯甲酸钾盐) and step (1) of the same example makes the potassium salt from potassium hydroxide. The prose reading is kept in the structured fields per the pass prompt's rule on drawing versus text, both readings are recorded here, and drawing_text_conflict is raised. Nothing is corrected. The rest of the arrow agrees with the prose: CF3CH2OK and HCl are both written in the procedure, and the drawn product matches the acid named in the text. THF and water are in the procedure and not on the arrow, which is ordinary omission of solvents from a scheme and is not flagged. LINKAGE: the text says 步骤(1)制备得到的 (prepared in step (1)) and the identifier of that step's product is the identifier charged here, so linkage_confirmed is true on both of rule 24's tests. This record also consumes the product of the Alkoxide Preparation record, which precursor_step cannot express because it holds one value; the alkoxide linkage is recorded here in prose instead. CONDITIONS: 控制釜温在5℃ gives the exact temperature. time_h is the 3 h hold after addition (加毕保温反应3h); the other 3 h is the total addition time and belongs to the benzoate salt's addition_profile, together with 分八次 (in eight portions). The vessel is again printed both ways, 釜 (kettle) for the temperature and 反应瓶 (reaction flask) for the addition. 负压脱溶 (solvent stripped off under negative pressure) is a workup operation, so it sets workup.concentration_method and not a reaction pressure. The hydrochloric acid is a workup acidification and not a reagent of the substitution, so it sits in workup with ph_target 2, and conditions.ph_value carries the same number with ph_target_stage naming the workup stage. The HPLC figure is a quantitative assay of the isolated product, not in-process monitoring, so it is on the product fields and process_control is left empty. ARITHMETIC: the printed figures close. The stated 93.5 percent is a two-step yield on methyl 2-chloro-3-(bromomethyl)-4-(methanesulfonyl)benzoate, not a yield for this step alone, and it is recorded as the product yield because the patent gives no other. 0.1 mol of that basis compound against the product molecular weight of 346.7 for C11H10ClF3O5S gives 34.67 g of theory; the printed 33.0 g at the printed 98.2 percent content is 32.41 g of target, which is 93.5 percent of theory and reproduces the printed yield exactly. No mass balance or molar mass flag is raised. The charge here, 0.1 mol at 98.3 percent, also matches step (1)'s 0.1 mol input and its 98.3 percent in-process content, so there is no scale discontinuity. The product name keeps the form A1 records; the patent prints no stereochemistry here and none is added.
